    SELECT f."School Type",
           COALESCE(f."School Name", s.School) AS "School Name",
           s.Latitude,
           COALESCE(f."School Type", s.SOCType) AS type_label
    FROM schools AS s
    LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode

),

    SELECT "School Type", "School Name", Latitude
    FROM school_records
    WHERE type_label IN ('Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)', 'Junior High Schools (Public)')
       OR (' ' || REPLACE("School Name", '/', ' ') || ' ') LIKE '% middle %'
       OR "School Name" LIKE '%junior high%'
       OR "School Name" LIKE '%jr. high%'
       OR "School Name" LIKE '%jr high%'
       OR "School Name" LIKE '%intermediate%'
)
SELECT "School Type", "School Name", Latitude
FROM middle_schools
WHERE Latitude = (SELECT MAX(Latitude) FROM middle_schools);

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT s.School, s.Charter, s.GSserved,
           f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS meal_rate,
           t.AvgScrRead + t.AvgScrMath + t.AvgScrWrite AS sat_total
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
      AND (s.GSserved = '12' OR s.GSserved LIKE '%-12')
)
SELECT School AS school_name,
       ROUND(meal_rate, 4) AS free_meal_rate,
       CASE Charter WHEN 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS is_charter,
       GSserved AS grades_served,
       CASE WHEN sat_total IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
            WHEN sat_total < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
            WHEN sat_total <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
            ELSE 'Above Average'
       END AS sat_performance_level
FROM eligible
WHERE meal_rate = (SELECT MAX(meal_rate) FROM eligible)
ORDER BY school_name;
```

    FROM superhero AS h
    JOIN race AS r ON r.id = h.race_id
    JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = h.gender_id
    LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = h.id
    WHERE r.race = 'God / Eternal' AND g.gender = 'Male'
    GROUP BY h.id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) AS average_superpowers
FROM powers_per_hero;

WITH labs AS (
    SELECT ID, LDH, TRIM("U-PRO") AS result
    FROM Laboratory
),
parsed AS (
    SELECT ID, LDH,
           CASE
               WHEN result GLOB '+[0-9](*)' THEN
                   TRIM(SUBSTR(result, 4, LENGTH(result) - 4))
               WHEN result LIKE '>=%' THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(result, 3))
               ELSE result
           END AS concentration
    FROM labs
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM parsed
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING MAX(LDH) >= 500
       AND MAX(CASE
                   WHEN concentration GLOB '*[0-9]*'
                    AND concentration NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*'
                    AND concentration NOT GLOB '*.*.*'
                   THEN CAST(concentration AS REAL)
               END) >= 100
)
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.ID = p.ID
ORDER BY p.ID;
```

    FROM atom AS a
    JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id

    GROUP BY a.element
)
SELECT element

ORDER BY element;
